designNotes: Decision table on status: Đã tập / Khách không đến (consume, credit) vs Hủy lịch / delete (neither).
Booking refusals: no sessions left, expired, overlap (BR-402, BR-403).

cases.title: "Đã tập" and "Khách không đến" reduce sessions left by 1 and credit the PT

steps.expected: Sessions left fall by exactly 1 and the PT gets 1 credit

steps.action: Mark another booked session "Khách không đến"
steps.expected: Sessions left fall by exactly 1 more and the PT gets 1 more credit

cases.manualReason: Needs a booking created earlier in the test and arithmetic across displayed counts.

cases.title: "Hủy lịch" neither consumes nor credits

steps.action: Cancel a booked session with "Hủy lịch"
steps.expected: Sessions left are unchanged and the PT gets no credit

cases.manualReason: Needs a booking created earlier in the test.

cases.title: Booking is refused with no sessions left, on an expired contract, or on an overlap

steps.action: Book on a contract with 0 sessions left
steps.expected: The booking is refused; no session is created

steps.action: Book the same PT at a time they already hold
